modsList.changelog:
Version 0.19.0:
- Boss special attack animations (e.g. grabs) are now synchronized when other players are the targets
- Fixed an issue where some notification banners would stay on the screen forever
- Chat commands are disabled during cutscenes, to avoid breaking the game
- Fixed collision issues when two players are using a shrine at the same time
- The launcher will now show a window for changing the room region, if there are no servers available in the selected region at the time. This is only relevant to the Shenzhen region which has a limited number of concurrent rooms that can be played at the same time (around 500).
- We are working on adding more servers in Mainland China in January.
- Fixed an issue where changing the game language would sometimes crash the game
- Fixed an issue where approaching a boss arena would sometimes crash the game

Version 0.18.4:
- The visual bane effects (fire, poison, shock, etc.) are now synchronized for enemies and players alike
- Attempting to skip a cutscene now displays how many players also voted for skipping it
- Disabled player collision after cutscenes, preventing being launched into the air
- The Quick as Fire boss in act 5 is now properly synchronized
- Fixed an issue where the Supreme Celestial Inspector's wall of fire was out of sync and  couldn't be dispelled by another player using the Plantain Fan
- Fixed an issue where if one played died during Yellowbrow's 1st phase, the boss wouldn't advance to the 2nd phase after being defeated by other players
- Fixed an issue where disconnecting while other fight Kang-Jin Star would make it impossible to interact with Zhu Bajie afterwards
- Fixed an issue where certain transformations would have missing weapons and not deal damage to enemies
- The effects of the Beguiling Chant debuff in the Pagoda Realm are now synchronized.
- Further improved detection of invisible walls around boss arenas
- Fixed an issue where picking up the Fireproof Mantle after defeating Elder Jinchi would soft-lock players on waiting for the cutscene to play
- Fixed an issue where reconnecting would break enemies that disguise as plants, making them attack while still underground
- Fixed an issue where other players would sometimes appear underground
- Fixed an issue where some players would appear invisible after rebirthing

Version 0.18.2:
- [co-op] Prologue and NG+ are now supported. New rooms will start from the Erlang fight sequence instead of the first act. After finishing the game you can continue with your save into New Game +.
- [co-op] The option to enter challenge mode is now disabled in shrines.
- [co-op] You should no longer be stuck on a cutscene if you die while fighting the Hundred-Eyed Daoist and he goes into his second phase
- [co-op] Free-floating camera UI no longer stays after you are resurrected using the Incense Trail Talisman

Version 0.18.0:
- [PvP] You can now use the /spectator command to toggle spectator status. As such, you don't participate in the fight, but you can observe using the free-floating camera.
- [PvP] Player health bars are now visible to opponents. Spectators see everyone's health bars.
- [PvP] Life-saving Strand and Maitreya's Orb effects are now properly synchronized. Players using the Strand will be reborn and the round will not end until they are actually dead.
- [PvP] Weaver's needle now attacks enemy players and monsters.
- [PvP] Weaver's needle and transformations reset on round end.
- [PvP] Players cannot be targeted while in Cloud Step. Only the decoy can be targeted. Weaver's needle will lose aggro on you if you Cloud Step.
- [PvP] Fixed an issue where the autosave icon would be permanently visible
- [PvP] When all players are ready, but one team doesn't have any players or monsters, a message will be displayed instead of soft-locking players into fighting in the same team with no enemies
- [PvP] Fixed an issue where some messages would be displayed in Windows language, and not game language
- [PvP] Shrines can no longer be used during a round
- [PvP] Players can no longer accidentally camera lock onto the other player's feet.
- [PvP] Beginning a round in Fallen Furnace Crater no longer teleports blue team players behind an invisible wall
- [PvP] Opponent transforming no longer causes you to lose camera lock-on

Version 0.15.0:
- Added Russian language support.
- Added missing translations to the co-op management view.
- Co-op room members' list now has a scroll bar, preventing overflow.
- Fixed an issue where the "Download save file" option wouldn't work for users on Windows Administrator accounts.
- Aligned button labels in the game mode selector.
- When all players are dead, they get reborn at the latest altar they visited.
- Resting at a shrine now restores HP to all players and resets monsters. Therefore, resting is now a team decision.
- If some players are dead, they will get resurrected when any other player rests at a shrine. The dead players are resurrected at that shrine (they get teleported).
- If any player triggers a cutscene, dead players are resurrected and teleported to the cutscene location. This is to prevent being soft-locked into waiting for cutscenes while others wait for being resurrected at a shrine.

Version 0.14.1:
- You can now travel between maps when finishing an act, visiting a hidden boss, or fast-travelling via shrines or the map.
- You can now join and leave the game at any time and in any order. The requirement for having the room owner join first no longer applies.
- Leaving the game does not de-sync enemies for other players.
- Zhu Baije and other NPCs no longer attack the player on sight, preventing story progression.
- This release also brings some performance improvements and a fix to the bug where you gained Focus when swinging at another player.
- Main menu button now says "Continue journey" instead of "New character".
- Fixed a bug where the cutscene at the beginning of Act 2 would only play for one player.

Version 0.14.0:
- Cutscenes are now skipped once all players vote to do so,
- Weaver's Needle skill is now synchronized,
- This update introduces automatic enemy HP scaling. Now, the enemy HP adjusts dynamically to the number of players as they join and leave the room. The formula is 150% extra HP per player,
- The co-op room view now displays the avatars of all members of the room.

Version 0.13.0:
- [co-op] Room owners now have the ability to kick other players out from the room,
- Fixed a bug where the modal windows (e.g. confirmation) wouldn't be translated to the selected language, but rather the system language,
- Added missing Chinese translations

Version 0.12.1:
- Fixed an issue that prevented the launcher from working on older, unpatched versions of Windows. If you tried to install the launcher before and the installation failed, you should try again now, by downloading a fresh installer from https://portal.ready.mp/.

Version 0.12.0:
- Added an option to log in with Discord. This only works if you've registered with Discord on the Player Portal (https://portal.ready.mp/) or linked a Discord account with your ReadyM account.
- Updated the visuals of the splash screen and the login window.

Version 0.11.1:
- Fixed an issue where the splash screen progress bar would be frozen for around 1 second when the aplication starts
- Updated ReadyM logo in the splash screen

Version 0.11.0:
- You can now upload save files to your room, while choosing whether to keep the character saves or not. This should allow you to test other acts than act 1, as changing maps is currently bugged.

Version 0.10.2:
- This update adds support for the Epic Games Launcher. This comes with updates to the co-op and PvP mods since we had to adapt them to work with both Steam and Epic.
- This update should also fix the issues introduced earlier on with the co-op mod not launching for some people.

Version 0.9.2:
- Room server can be changed by the room owner only - other players all join the selected server,
- Players no longer see each other in cutscenes, breaking immersion,
- [co-op] Server is now selected once by the room owner when creating a room,
- Players should no longer get stuck in slow-motion when fighting certain bosses,
- The I keybind from PvP was removed and will no longer break co-op games,
- Player names are now white.

Version 0.9.0:
- This version brings the long-awaited co-op mode for WukongMP! For now, the game mode will only show up for players selected for closed alpha tests, but we'll expand that group gradually over the week. Later on, we'll open access for everyone.
- Also, we added a new server to the pool, located in Western Europe (Frankfurt), which you can also use for your PvP games.

Version 0.8.4:
- Updated Chinese translation of the Fallen Furnace Crater map to 天真顶
- We updated the networking library to fix an issue which sometimes would result in a game crash. This is probably the last update to the PvP mode before the co-op releases.

Version 0.8.3:
- No visible changes, just a small patch to make sure PvP still works while we deploy the co-op alpha!

Version 0.8.2:
- Added support for multiple game modes
- Fixes and improvements

Version 0.8.1:
- Added some missing translations.

Version 0.8:
- The launcher is now available in 8 languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, Polish, Portuguese, Vietnamese, and French.
- Discontinued support for server mod sync in Valheim and Sons of The Forest.
- Added a "log out" button in the top right corner of the Wukong window.

Version 0.7.2:
- Error messages are now more helpful when creating and joining rooms.

Version 0.7.1:
- Hidden the "Same as host" NG+ selector as it would cause boss HP to not sync properly if other players had characters with a different NG+ level than host. Will restore the option after we fix that

Version 0.7:
- Overhauled room creation UI - customize game rooms with options such as allowed spells and items, monster difficulty level (New Game+ scaling) and map selection.
- Choose one of two servers - one in east US (North America) server and one in Hong Kong (East Asia). All players must select the same server to play in the same room.
- Matchmaking is gone as hardly anyone used it successfully (time zones). Use the ⁠#matchmaking Discord channel to find other players to play with.
- All the goodies that come with the launcher update - more locations to choose from and a customizable PvP experience.
- Flying Nimbus synchronization (players' characters must have the ability unlocked).
- Completely new netcode should fix most disconnection issues plaguing the previous versions of the mod (or at least we hope it will).
- Major performance improvements for monster synchronization. We tested a 2 players vs 40 monsters fight without dropping a single update. Previous versions would start lagging behind at about 10 monsters.
- Added an in-game ping indicator to top right corner of the UI.
- Monster ranged attack desync is mostly fixed. Some edge cases remain (e.g. Erlang's immobilize).

Version 0.6.2:
- Updated the expired Discord invite link under the "Report Feedback" button

Version 0.6.1:
- New commands for spawning enemies and bosses! Fight against any number of regular enemies and bosses at a time, solo or with your teammates. You can also join the monsters' team and have them support you in a fight against your friends.
- Alone in a room? Press I to fight against two Chosen One bots. Bots do not spawn if you spawn any other enemies to fight against.
- Joining a room while a fight is in progress will enable free camera mode (spectator mode). Spectators are now visible in the player list in the upper-left corner. Spectators spawn in after the tournament ends.
- New command: /giveup. Use it when you want to quickly end the round if you get stuck waiting for the timeout.
- Increased round time to 5 minutes.
- Reduced the size of the launcher a little bit
- Changed the layout of the log-in page

Version 0.6:
- You can now specify custom Black Myth: Wukong installation folder, in case the launcher fails to find the default Steam installation path. This enables you to play WukongMP if you have installed the game through platforms other than Steam.
